Until 2026-09-18 that left priced_lean_pct as -0.05 * run_up_20d_pct, which is ALSO the free control, so the baseline's lean and its own benchmark were the same number. They are no longer: `positioning` and `expected_move` below carry substitutes built from what Tokyo does publish, and this baseline supplies its own `priced_lean_pct` and `anchor_quality`.

history.caveat: Announcement DATES are estimated by applying this quarter's notified lag backwards to prior period ends; the move is the largest within +/-2 trading days of that estimate. This is a cadence prior, not a record that a print happened on that date. Use it as a scale for how much this name moves, never as evidence about a particular past date.

event_plausibility.basis: issuer-notified date carried by JPX on the 決算発表予定日 sheet

positioning.basis: absent from the JPX register, so no disclosed position at or above the 0.5% threshold. A real zero, not missing data -- but the threshold truncates, so 0.4% and 0.0% are both recorded here as 0.0.
positioning.margin_ratio_basis: 信用倍率, margin long balance / margin short balance, scraped from a broker portal rather than published by the exchange. Null is a normal outcome.

expected_move.basis: the larger of (a) the median of twelve ESTIMATED prior reactions and (b) a one-session move implied by 20-day realised volatility. It is NOT an option-implied move: nothing is paying for it, and it carries no information about what the market expects from THIS print. It is a scale for how far this name travels.

baseline.priced_lean_basis: Sum of the components above. Read researcher_japan/scripts/jp_priced_in.py, lean_components(): every weight is a PRIOR, none is measured on Japanese data, and jp_resolve.py ranks each component separately so measurement can replace them. What matters today is only that this is no longer identical to -0.05 * run_up_20d_pct, so the free control is a real rival again.

anchor_quality.basis: magnitude: realised vol plus an estimated-cadence reaction history, capped at 0.5 because neither is an option-implied move. direction: how many of the three positioning components resolved, capped at 0.60 because none of them is 25-delta skew.

evidence.text: H1 operating profit is likely 3.7-5.0bn yen (Q1 1,729m plus a Q2 of about 2.0-3.3bn), at or above the 3,700m full-year plan. Shochiku has revised at every results print in FY26/2, so an upward revision with today's 14:00 release is likely. evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last two H1 prints: 2024-10-11 -10.36% (H1 OP 715) and 2025-10-15 +12.37% (FY ordinary raised 50% on a surprise H1). Other revisions were not reliably bought: 2025-07-15 net +45% -2.59%, 2026-01-14 ordinary +27% -2.04%. The 2026-07-14 Q1 (47% progress, plan held) went +3.88%. All from the baseline's estimated-cadence history, with the dates matching kabutan's results headlines.
evidence.why_not_priced: The plan itself is clearly not the bar: the stock trades at 67.8x plan EPS and the one consensus number is about 50% above the plan, so 'there will be a revision' is mostly in the price. What is not observable yet is its size against 5,275m. If the market expected a revision well above consensus, the stock would have moved toward the 13,100 target in the last 20 sessions; it is flat (-0.37%), and margin shorts exceed margin longs, so nobody is crowded long into the print. The Q2 inputs (TOHO's monthly box office series, film grosses) are public but have not been turned into a published Shochiku H1 number.
evidence.independence: Three different documents feed the H1 estimate. (1) TOHO's own cinema series, Jun-Aug 2026: 4,936/8,340/9,797m against 5,823/9,096/10,583m, -9.5% (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261009/140120260929542010.pdf). Shochiku's MOVIX tracked it within 1pt in Q1 FY27 (+10.1% vs +9.4%) and Q2 FY26 (+64% vs +63%) per Shochiku's Q1 deck (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260713592605.pdf). (2) Shochiku-distributed hits: 黒牢城 passed 10億 in a month (https://realsound.jp/book/2026/07/post-2470558.html); the あの星 sequel opened ahead of its 45億 predecessor (https://movie.jorudan.co.jp/news/jrd_260810_01/). (3) The prior conservative-revision pattern (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251015/140120251014573061.pdf). The counterweight sits inside this one finding, not in a second one: Q2 FY26 OP was a very high 3,158 and the Osaka Shochikuza farewell boost to Q1 演劇 (1,351m) does not repeat after the theatre closed in May.

evidence.independence: Same Q1 deck as finding 1's segment base; it shares a document, not a conclusion. Nothing independent points the same way.

evidence.text: The forecast decision is the print. Morito held its FY plan at Q1 (OP progress 29.7%) and at H1 (OrdP 58.4% against a 5-year average of 50.5%, implying H2 OrdP -19.6% y/y). The street already sits above plan (consensus OrdP 3,975m vs 3,700m). On a normal Q3 (OrdP ~950-1,000m) cumulative progress reaches ~84-86%, the highest at any Q3 in its record (80.1% in FY2025). Its own Q3 revision record is mixed: revised in 2021 and 2023 (+10.2% OrdP on 2023-10-13), held in 2022, 2024 and 2025. The 2025 hold came at 80.1% progress and the stock fell ~2%. The FY ended 9.8% above plan with no profit revision, only a +1 yen dividend in November. Probability-weighted: ~45% a revision to around consensus (+3), ~55% a hold read as the usual conservatism (-1.8).
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY2025 (2025-10-10 11:30, plan held at 80.1% progress): -1.96% to the close and -2.46% to the next close. Q1 FY2026 (2026-04-14 11:30, record quarter, plan held): -0.52% / -1.56%. H1 FY2026 (2026-07-14 13:00, plan held but DOE raise, progressive dividend, buyback and new MTP): +4.70% / +1.98%. Q3 FY2023 (2023-10-13 after the close, OrdP plan +10.2%): -3.5% the next session, on a weak market day. Prices from the Yahoo chart in the baseline sources.
evidence.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. The stock trades at ~15x the company's own EPS (121 yen) and has gone nowhere since H1 (1,850 on 7/14, 1,824 now), so the price is not paying for a revision as a certainty. Had the market priced a revision in, the stock would have run up into the print; it did not (+0.55% over 5 days). Had it priced a hold, a margin-long book of 27.9x would already have been unwinding. What is not priced is which way the company goes this time, and its own record is split 2/3.
evidence.independence: Consensus level from kabuyoho (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9837). Plan-hold language from the H1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714592818.pdf, '現在のところ変更はございません'). 2023 Q3 revision from kabutan (https://s.kabutan.jp/stocks/9837/news/k202310130072/). These are separate documents, but all three bear on one decision and count once.

evidence.text: Q3 (Jun-Aug) is the first quarter this year with both acquisitions fully in the prior-year base: Ms.ID was consolidated from 2024-12-25 and Mitsuboshi from 2025-04-01 (per the H1 短信). It also laps a record-heat summer that drove 猛暑対策商品 and 空調服 materials: summer 2025 was +2.36C, ranked 1st, and summer 2026 was +1.02C, ranked 5th. Q3 growth is therefore likely low single digits after Q2's +7.3% OP. Q2 margin already slipped from 7.0% to 6.2%.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has sold quarter-only prints even when they beat: Q3 FY2025, with Q3 OrdP +29% y/y, fell ~2.5%; Q1 FY2026, with OP +68%, fell ~1.6%. The quarter itself has not been the line that moves it up.
evidence.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The acquisition dates are in the public 短信 and the weather data is public, so anyone can compute the tougher comparison. It is filed small because no Japanese source on this name frames Q3 as the organic-comparison quarter. Kabutan's automatic headline will compare Q3 y/y against a strong 933m base.
evidence.independence: Weather from nippon.com (https://www.nippon.com/ja/japan-data/h02891/): summer 2026 ranked 5th and 2025 ranked 1st. That is a macro proxy, and the transmission to the company is an inference.

evidence.text: No capital-return item is likely at this print. The DOE raise to 5.0% and progressive dividend explicitly apply from the FY Nov-2027 dividend. The buyback (up to 300k shares / ¥600m, 2026-07-16 to 2027-01-12) had bought only 50,000 shares / ¥90.5m by 9/30, at about 20,900 shares a month. evidence.why_not_priced: Nothing to price. This finding records that the one line this stock has rallied on is unlikely to be in this release, which removes upside tail rather than adding a sign.
evidence.independence: DOE timing in a separate notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714592884.pdf: '2027年11月期の配当より適用').
